questions.q: What did the study of investment bankers working 15-hour days find?
a: Sleeplessness, weight shifts, hair loss and panic attacks
Higher salaries but lower job satisfaction
Fewer sick days because of their youth
Better focus from working long uninterrupted hours
questions.why: Lesson 1 lists sleep problems, shifting weight, hair loss and panic attacks among the effects on junior bankers, plus disease after four years.

questions.q: How much more productive does the summary say happy workers are?
a: 22 percent more productive
10 percent more productive
50 percent more productive
83 percent more productive
questions.why: Lesson 1 cites data showing a 22 percent productivity edge for employees who are happy at work.

questions.q: What does the research say about eating lunch alone?
a: It breeds unhappiness nearly as bad as mental illness
It helps people recharge faster than eating with colleagues
It has no measurable effect on mood or productivity
It improves concentration for the rest of the day
questions.why: Lesson 2 says eating lunch alone produces unhappiness close to that of a mental illness.

A silent meditation retreat taken during work hours
A rule against checking email before lunch
A day each week spent working from home

questions.q: Which working pattern did research find more productive?
a: Taking Sunday off and working 48 hours a week
Working 56 hours a week with no day off
Working 40 hours a week with no breaks
Working six shorter days instead of five long ones
questions.why: Lesson 3 cites research that people who take Sunday off and work 48 hours get more done than those working 56 without a day off.
